ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution; high-intensity (white) pixels are limited to small, localized clusters at the distal tips and scattered noise, resulting in a low macro-level contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark pixel distribution across the visible surface of both lobes; no macro-level contiguous mottling or geometric banding patterns detected.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a deep, narrow profile; calculated interior angle of approximately 22 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge boundary; moderate frequency variations with extreme amplitude peaks and valleys at the distal margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Generally convex sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips; sweep is interrupted at the outer margins by highly irregular, non-linear terminations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-contrast white pixels located at the far distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, diagonal linear pixel disruptions detected on the mid-section of the left lobe lobe, oriented toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregularity and ragged tissue loss observed at the distal margins of both fluke lobes, particularly prominent on the far-right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The distal margins exhibit a highly 'torn' or eroded geometric profile compared to standard species-level expected morphology.
